integrity: The all-set characterization follows directly from multipartite neighborhoods. The support minimum is proved by an exact bounded-allocation argument. The checker separately reconstructs adjacency, domination, capacity constraints, coefficient counts, and the minimum formula.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs with at least three parts and the nontrivial range one through maximum degree minus one.
The exact minimum is expressed as a finite optimization over part-support subsets rather than a single order statistic.
The exhaustive verifier covers total order at most nine; the arbitrary-order theorem is analytic.
title: All k-limited dominating sets of multipartite graphs with at least three parts
